summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Fidelity Momentum Factor ETF (FDMO) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Fidelity U.S. Momentum Factor index. The fund tracks an index large-cap US stocks selected for positive momentum signals. FDMO was launched on Sep 12, 2016 and is issued by Fidelity.

holdings.infoBox: FDMO is an equity ETF with a total of 139 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 8.70%, Apple at 7.96%, Alphabet at 5.40%, Amazon.com at 3.43%, and Micron Technology at 2.93%.
